target: D63 Notes autosave candidate, with narrow D64/D65 source review

A_source_outcome.D63_original_data_loss: The original same-note overlapping-save loss is addressed in current source: persist retains the latest queued draft and drains it after the in-flight write; onAppend shares this path; each note editor is keyed by noteId so a switch creates separate refs and write queues; failed drafts are retained by ID and have a visible retry.
A_source_outcome.switch_and_unmount: The keyed NoteEditor at NotesView prevents a new note's snapshot from entering the old note's queue. Old editor cleanup can flush its latest draft; if its write fails after unmount, the draft is retained in the unsavedDrafts map for later reopening.

remaining_source_finding.title: Returning to the saved value leaves status stuck at Saving
reproduction: Open a note with a known saved body and wait until the editor is idle.
Change the body, then restore it exactly to the original value before the 600 ms debounce expires.
Wait for the debounce to settle.
remaining_source_finding.expected: Because the final draft equals the saved snapshot, no write is needed and the status returns to Saved (or idle) rather than claiming a write is active.
remaining_source_finding.actual: updateDraft sets savingState to saving. persist detects sameDraft(writing, savedRef.current), clears the matching unsaved draft and continues without changing savingState. No network update starts, so the indicator remains Saving indefinitely.
remaining_source_finding.severity: S3: status remains misleading after an edit is reverted; note data is not lost
remaining_source_finding.priority: P2: visible save status is inaccurate
remaining_source_finding.next_fix: When the queued snapshot equals savedRef.current, clear the matching unsaved draft and set an honest settled status (Saved with the last successful timestamp, or idle when no timestamp exists). Add a regression assertion that no update request occurs and Saving disappears.

B_test_quality.assessment: The five autosave cases exercise the real NotesView/NoteEditor component path with controlled update promises and fake debounce timers; they assert both request snapshots and final stored contents. This is a meaningful guard for the original issue, note identity separation, append serialization, unmount flush, and failure recovery/retry.

coverage_mapping.D63-A1: Overlapping same-note edits; checks second write carries latest body and only latest success displays Saved.
coverage_mapping.D63-A2: Switch to B during A write; asserts distinct note IDs and stored values.
coverage_mapping.D63-A3: Append during pending save; checks appended content reaches storage.
coverage_mapping.D63-A4: Unmount with a newer queued draft; checks trailing write reaches storage.
coverage_mapping.failure_retry: Null update response leaves original stored value, shows Save failed, recovers draft after switching away/back, and persists it on Retry save.

B_test_quality.gap: No case covers edit-then-revert to the currently saved snapshot; the source-only D63-PEER-01 path would leave Saving visible forever.
B_test_quality.execution: This peer did not run the suite. The separate guarded 5/5 result was not independently reproduced here.
